mainEntity.name: Can I use my square face as an avatar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can use your square face as a Discord PFP, GitHub avatar, Notion icon, favicon, or social profile picture.

mainEntity.name: Do I need Adobe Flash Player?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The game runs in modern browsers with Ruffle, so you do not need to install Adobe Flash Player.

mainEntity.name: How do I save my square face icon?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the in-game save option if it works in your browser, or take a screenshot and crop it into a square icon.
